title: More datatypes
description:
###### You are on part 1/3 of this lesson.

---
The text on the right shows all the other datatypes.
To print variables, you use _formaters_ in qout.
Formaters just tell QuantumC the type of data you want to print. Formaters are values in the format %<formater>, and you put them in the string and pass aditional arguments to qout AFTER the string (seperated by commas), such as this: `int aInt = 1234; qout("integer %i", aInt); // prints integer 1234`. (read along with the datatypes example)
| Type | Formater |
| ---- | -------- |
| Int | `%i` |
| Float | `%f` |
| Double | `&d` |
| Char | `%c` |
| String | `%s` |
| Bool | `%b` |
| QBool | `%q` |

// THIS IS A NON-RUNNING DEMO.

string s; // Stores a string of text.
qbool quantum; // Stores qtrue, qfalse, none, or both.
